slides.title: Making Requests
slides.content:
# HTTP Made Easy 📨

Forget `urllib`. Use Requests.

```python
import requests

# GET
r = requests.get('https://api.github.com/events')
print(r.status_code) # 200
print(r.json()) # Parsed JSON

# POST (Sending Data)
payload = {'key': 'value'}
r = requests.post('https://httpbin.org/post', data=payload)
```

slides.title: Headers & Auth
slides.content:
# Customizing Calls 🔧

## Headers
Pretend to be a browser or send API tokens.
```python
headers = {'user-agent': 'my-app/0.0.1'}
r = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
```

## Authentication
```python
from requests.auth import HTTPBasicAuth
r = requests.get(url, auth=('user', 'pass'))
```

slides.title: Session Objects
slides.content:
# Persistence 🍪

A `Session` object persists cookies across requests (great for staying logged in).

```python
s = requests.Session()

# Login sets a cookie
s.post('http://httpbin.org/cookies/set/sessioncookie/123456789')

# Next request sends the cookie automatically
r = s.get('http://httpbin.org/cookies')
print(r.text)
```
